chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Abu Ayyub at the Syrian coast narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Harun al-Masisi narrated to us, saying: Khalid ibn Yazid al-Qasri narrated to us, saying: Umayy al-Sayrafi narrated to me, saying: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, say:

"Allah disowns whoever disowns us; may Allah curse whoever curses us; may Allah destroy whoever is our enemy. O Allah, You know that we are the means of guidance for them, and they only oppose us for Your sake, so be You alone the One to inflict punishment upon them."

key_terms.الْمُنْفَرِدَ بِعَذَابِهِمْ: the sole executor of their punishment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about those who disown the Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) delivers a powerful supplication affirming that the Ahlul Bayt are the divinely appointed means of guidance for the community. He calls upon Allah to hold accountable those who disown, curse, or oppose them, while noting that such enmity is ultimately directed at God Himself. This teaching, transmitted through multiple narrators including scholars from the Syrian coast and al-Masisah, reflects the Imam's deep confidence in the Ahlul Bayt's divinely ordained role.
